title: Generalized Chern number bounds for matroids
statement:
Let $M$ be a simple matroid of rank $d+1$ on a ground set $E$ of size $n$. For nonnegative integers $k_1,\ldots,k_d$ with $k_1+2k_2+\cdots+dk_d=d$, consider the Chern number $\bar{c}_1^{k_1}\cdots \bar{c}_d^{k_d}(M)$ and the corresponding Chern number of the uniform matroid $U_{d+1,n}$. **Generalized Chern number bounds conjecture.** The Chern numbers of $M$ satisfy

$$
|\bar{c}_1^{k_1}\cdots \bar{c}_d^{k_d}(M)| \leq |\bar{c}_1^{k_1}\cdots \bar{c}_d^{k_d}(U_{d+1,n})|.
$$

Equality holds if and only if $M=U_{3,n}$. This conjecture proposes that the upper bounds proved for simple matroids of rank $3$ extend to matroids of arbitrary rank; the supplied text does not provide evidence resolving the conjecture.
source_name: Eline Mannino, “Chern Numbers of Matroids”, arXiv:2310.01956 (2023).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.01956

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2023).
